review_candidates.description: Skrbite da so procesi urejeni, podatki pravilni in plače zaposlenih obračunane pravočasno ter skladno z zakonodajo. V našo ekipo vabimo izkušenega sodelavca ali sodelavko na področju obračuna plač, ki bo izvajal/a obračun plač v podjetju, ki zaposluje več kot 1000 sodelavcev. Če dobro poznate obračun plač, radi delate s podatki, redno spremljate zakonodajo na tem področju in brez težav pomagate drugim pri razumevanju plačnih procesov, potem morda iščemo prav vas! Vaše delo bo obsegalo Širše področje obračuna plač in sodelovanje z različnimi oddelki. Glavne Naloge samostojno izvajanje obračuna plač in drugih prejemkov ter izplačil, skrb za pravilnost, pravočasnost in zakonitost vseh obračunov, spremljanje sprememb delovnopravne in druge zakonodaje, ki vpliva na področje dela, ter njihovo ustrezno vključevanje v procese, skrb za pravilno arhiviranje dokumentacije, priprava analiz, evidenc in poročil s področja obračuna plač, kontrola podatkov ter prepoznavanje in odpravljanje morebitnih nepravilnosti, sodelovanje z drugimi organizacijskimi enotami in oddelki pri zagotavljanju pravilnosti podatkov, pomoč in svetovanje zaposlenim ter drugim uporabnikom pri vprašanjih, povezanih z obračunom plač in prejemki, izobraževanje in podpora sodelavcem, ki sodelujejo v procesih, povezanih z obračunom plač, reševanje zahtevnejših situacij, vprašanj in morebitnih neskladij na področju obračuna, skrb za izboljšave na področju dela. Pričakujemo najmanj 4 leta delovnih izkušenj na področju obračuna plač v podjetju, VI/1. stopnjo izobrazbe ekonomske ali druge ustrezne smeri, poznavanje delovnopravne zakonodaje in predpisov, povezanih z obračunom plač, analitično razmišljanje in sposobnost dela z večjo količino podatkov, zelo dobro poznavanje dela z računalnikom, predvsem MS Office, natančnost in sistematičnost pri delu, organizacijske sposobnosti, sposobnost timskega sodelovanja in dobre komunikacijske sposobnosti zaradi sodelovanja z različnimi oddelki in zaposlenimi, zaželene izkušnje z obračunom plač v podjetjih z večjim številom zaposlenih in poznavanje programa Navision. Kaj ponujamo? Zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s 6-mesečno poskusno dobo, delo v stabilnem podjetju, ki je del ene največjih skupin na področju mobilnosti v regiji, delo v okolju z močno digitalno in razvojno podporo, kjer lahko svoje znanje in izkušnje nadgrajuješ, delo v ekipi, kjer cenimo timsko sodelovanje, prenos znanja in generiranje novih idej, Sveže sadje in jutranja kava, možnost članstva v Nomago Sport. Kraj opravljanja dela Ljubljana. Začetek dela Po dogovoru Rok prijave 30.11.2026 Način prijave Svojo prijavo oddajte izključno preko povezave spodaj, kjer boste odgovorili na nekaj kratkih vprašanj in priložili svoj življenjepis, iz katerega bodo razvidne vaše dosedanje izkušnje. Želim se prijaviti

Liaising, as needed, with other CD providers to ensure complementarity and coordination in the support provided to member countries. review_candidates.title: Regional Manager
review_candidates.description: Position: Regional Manager Country/Regional Name: Ghana Reporting to: General Managers, Commodities _________________________________________________________________________ POSITION SUMMARY: Ecom Agrotrade, a leading global commodity merchant and sustainable supply chain management company, is seeking a highly motivated, target‐driven, innovative commercial manager with a track record of excellence in marketing, sales, distribution and fund management on a regional or national scale in Ghana or West Africa. Our new cadre of Regional Manager will oversee the buying of cocoa as well as manage sustainability activities in relation with the commodity. Our new combined operational/ field structure that aims to ensure that we create rural prosperity for the farmers, brings together the cocoa, sustainability management services (SMS) businesses, an even more farmer focused, farmer friendly business model for our network of over 80,000 smallholder farmers across the country. In so doing, we not only foster loyalty but also help our farmers invest in themselves, thereby increasing rural prosperity. The Regional Manager will have oversight of approximately six to twelve districts, including a team of 12 or more franchise holders (both, Cocoa and Products and Services), approximately 250 purchasing clerks. The Regional Manager reports directly into our profit centre General Managers. He or she will manage programmes for key clients. The Regional Manager is based in the field and travels frequently into the Districts as well as in and out of Ecom’s Ghana Head Office in Kumasi. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: The Regional Manager will have the following key responsibilities for his districts: Execute the buying of cocoa Ensure cocoa targeted volumes and quality parameters are met Ensure zero outstanding cash with upcountry agents Ensures no cross-border trade is entertained and all agents work within the permissible boundaries. Ensure well‐coordinated internal controls and record keeping systems are in place Ensures that all company assets and tools of trade are protected and safeguarded. Business performance tracking including financial management and reporting Manage P&L for the Region. This is done through cost reduction strategies in the course of carrying your duties Set and track procurement budgets and forecasts Set and track credit limits and analyze PE ratios on weekly basis Report on procurement and recoveries on weekly basis Customer relations Has good customer relations with all stakeholders (i.e. Chiefs, Police, Field Operatives) Has the ability to obtain information from competition Ability to command respect from all his/her direct reports and ensures he/she motivates the team for the achievement of the company objectives. Commitment and compliance with new regulations and requirements that may be introduced. Ensure that all his reports/subordinates submit their weekly reports/returns (cocoa & SMS) on time for a consolidated reports to Head Office. Innovation and technology development Support the development and set up of Digital Payment System (DPP) platforms within the region to ensure easy payment to farmers. Ensure FHs enter data on daily basis on the platforms that the company will provide to track prefinance and other parameters eg. Empower. Provide a feedback loop for new opportunities that support growth Sustainability management services and training Ensure all certifications are up to date and all audits passed successfully Manage all sustainability projects for key clients (including chocolate makers and donors) Ensure measures are put in place to reduce carbon emissions. These include distribution of cocoa seedlings to farmers, shade tree distributions among others. Ensure payment to farmers are done fairly in compliance with company ethical policies Ensures that from time to time all developmental projects in the region (i.e. schools, boreholes etc. ) are inspected to understand their statuses. People management and development Supports the selection and on‐boarding process of staff/franchise holders in the region Ensures the Ecom Culture is cultivated in the region Co‐ordinate the activities of staff/franchise holders across the region, including managing performance, motivation and training requirements QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: Qualifications: Essential: Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, marketing, sales or another business related field is required. An MBA or Master’s degree in a related field is desirable. Minimum of 5 ‐ 10 years’ experience, including at least 5 year’s working experience in a proven commercial management position Proven track record of developing and leading high performing marketing/ sales teams at regional or national level, ideally with a multi‐national or Blue Chip company. Knowledge and experience of the rural sector, farming communities, agribusiness products and distributional channels are an advantage Skill set: Entrepreneurial and bottom of the pyramid skill sets Strong interpersonal, problem solving and negotiation skills Analytical with a good head for figures Excellent verbal communication (English, Twi) and written communication including the ability to produce clear presentations and reports Innovative, Proficient in MSOffice (including MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint) Willing to be based and travel extensively across the rural communities in Ghana. Gender diversity is encouraged Ability to drive with a valid Ghanaian License

Broad engineering knowledge across mechanical, electrical, fire protection, tank and pipeline systems, with the judgement to involve specialists where required. Experience in owning the maintenance portfolio to a Global and Regional management level Key Relationships Internal Terminal Managers Maintenance Supervisors Project Managers HSE Managers Procurement Managers Resident Engineers Site Construction Managers/Supervisors Site Maintenance Staff Finance Team External Material Suppliers Engineering and Steel companies Inspection Bodies Construction companies Service companies
